definition: a day when everything goes wrong
description: A living room at night with rain on the window. A young woman with soaking wet hair, in a wet rust coat, dark skirt and black high heels, lies collapsed face down over a green velvet sofa, her arms hanging onto the rug and her legs up on the cushions. Her tote bag lies dropped on the floor. A black cat leaps off the sofa and walks away. A young man in a navy hoodie sits on a chair holding a mug, stares at her, then gets up, leans over and pats her on the back with a smile.

de.answer: Sie liegt ausgestreckt quer über dem Samtsofa.
phrases: ausgestreckt quer über dem Sofa liegen
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está despatarrada en el sofá de terciopelo.
